decisions.reason: The candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already captures the five-clip submission deadline, channel, and late-delivery consequence; the approval timing is independently owned by the approval-gate Requirement.
Review and approval timing for the new five-clip publication batch does not change the already completed qualification process.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records Friday publication as contingent on Thursday-morning delivery and client approval, fully representing the cross-Requirement effect.
The five-clip batch and its pre-publication approval timing do not necessarily resume or alter the deferred 100-approved-clips-per-month quota.
Approval timing does not change permitted or required source materials; the source-material changes are already captured by this candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Requiring client approval before publication does not change the clip's completeness or standalone-comprehension standard.
The approval schedule does not change the existing white-text, prescribed-font, and no-effects caption requirements.
The pre-publication approval timing does not alter the clean, simple, no-heavy-animation editing standard.
The client reviewing the current five-clip batch does not change the freelancer's future Lead Clipper pathway or responsibilities for reviewing other clippers' work.
Approval timing does not alter the already established 45-to-60-second duration requirement.
The current batch's approval timing does not establish or change an independently represented impactful-moment selection standard.
